excel.name: 01. Merge Excel
excel.blocks:
What should it look like after merging?

If you want to gather data by department into one file but view each table separately, choose merge by sheet. To stack lists with the same columns vertically, use vertical merge. To combine tables with the same row order side-by-side, use horizontal merge.

Horizontal merge is not a feature for looking up customer numbers or employee IDs to link the same person. If the row order of the two tables differs, incorrect values may be placed side-by-side, so always check the data order first. After saving the result, check the number of sheets, the first and last rows, and a few key formulas.
excel.examples: Example: Leaving January and February data in separate tabs is merge by sheet; appending transaction details of the same columns downward is vertical merge. Horizontal merge assumes the row order of both datasets is identical. Do not state that the header row is automatically kept only once.
excel.faqs:
Should I use merge or compare?
Choose merge to combine multiple datasets into one file, and Excel Compare to find what has changed between two datasets.

What should I check in the merged result?
First, check the order of files and sheets, repeated column header rows, missing rows, and the references and displayed values of formulas. Keep the original files stored separately until result verification is complete.

excelCompare.name: 02. Compare Excel
excelCompare.blocks:
"Changed" is different from "Unable to connect"

Compare similar tables before and after revisions by matching rows and columns. For lists with different orders, use a reference item like an employee ID or product code that can identify the same target. To verify transactions with matching amounts, dates, and clients, use the transaction matching feature.

Changes in the results indicate that the values of connected items are different. Duplicate or ambiguously connected items are not definitively incorrect data; they simply mean it's difficult to uniquely identify the same target. For such items, check the original and secondary criteria together.
excelCompare.examples: Example data: Left has 10 P-01 / 20 P-02, Right has 25 P-02 / 10 P-01. By linking based on the product code, even with a different order, you can read that P-01 has the same quantity and P-02 has changed. Create an actual fixture to verify it matches the report before posting as a screen example.
excelCompare.faqs:
Can I use names as the reference item?
If the same name can appear multiple times, first look for values that can uniquely identify the item, such as employee IDs or order numbers. Also, review duplicate lists for results connected only by name.

What if there are far more changed items than expected?
First, check if the sheets and column header rows to be compared match, and whether the display format or spacing of dates and numbers differ. Manually compare a few rows of the original before drastically changing the tolerance.

excelCleaner.name: 03. Clean Excel
excelCleaner.blocks:
Define the criteria for "duplicates" before deleting rows

The same name doesn't always mean the same person, and the same product name with a different order number could be a different transaction. Decide which columns will be used as criteria for identical data before applying duplicate cleanup or row deletion.

Try applying just one rule with a minor change first, like whitespace cleanup. Since rules are executed from top to bottom, the result of cleaning up whitespace followed by removing duplicates can differ from the reverse order. Check not only the result file but also the changed or excluded items in the processing report.
excelCleaner.examples: Example: "Seoul " and "Seoul" can become the same value after whitespace cleanup. However, if "0012" and "12" are product codes, they might be different values, so do not apply number conversion first.
excelCleaner.faqs:
I want to keep the leading zeros in the codes.
Distinguish between numbers for calculation and employee IDs, product codes, or phone numbers. Check the relevant column before applying number conversion, and verify a sample of the result to see if the leading zeros remain.

The number of rows in the cleaned file decreased.
Check the selected rules, such as delete empty rows, remove duplicates, or filters. Don't just compare the row counts of the original and the result; also look at the reasons for exclusion in the processing report.

converter.name: 04. Convert Table Data
converter.blocks:
Convert the same table so other programs can read it

Use this to turn a CSV saved in Excel into JSON to pass to a program, or to create an HTML table to embed in a webpage. This tool does not rewrite the table's content; it simply converts the same data into a different display format.

Ensure that the column names in the first row, like 'Name' or 'Quantity', are clear. Since some cells might contain commas or line breaks, it is better to check the number of rows/columns and cell contents in the conversion result rather than simply splitting the CSV by commas in Notepad.
converter.examples:
CSV Example:

Product,Quantity
Note,3
Pen,5

JSON Example:

[{"Product":"Note","Quantity":"3"},{"Product":"Pen","Quantity":"5"}]

This example is a conceptual illustration using string values. Whether numeric types are actually inferred will be confirmed by running the current converter before posting.
converter.faqs:
Are Excel's colors and formulas transferred too?
This is a data conversion between CSV, JSON, and HTML tables. Do not use it as a tool to transfer the cell formatting, formulas, or charts of an Excel workbook exactly as they are.

What should I check if Korean characters are garbled?
Check the character encoding settings used to read the CSV and how the original file was saved. First, look at the preview before conversion to see if the Korean characters and delimiters are read correctly.

pdfEditor.name: 05. PDF Tools
pdfEditor.blocks:
Decide first whether to organize the PDF as is or convert it to another file

Use page editing to merge submission files into one or keep only the necessary pages. This is not for rewriting text content, but for organizing the sequence, structure, and orientation of pages.

Choose PDF to Image to use pages like photos, or Image to PDF to bind multiple photos into one document. Use Document Conversion to bring PDF text into an editable document, or OCR to add searchable text to scanned documents. Always compare the result with the original text after conversion.
pdfEditor.examples: Task selection cards: "Combine 3 submission documents into one" → Merge, "Only pages 2-4 of a contract" → Split/Extract, "Pages to PNG" → Image, "Search words in a scanned copy" → OCR. Use composite examples instead of real documents.
pdfEditor.faqs:
Can I edit the PDF body text directly in page editing?
This screen handles page sequencing, deletion, rotation, extraction, and finishing marks. To rewrite the body text, you must edit the conversion result or the original document file in a separate editor.

Are Image Conversion and OCR the same feature?
Image Conversion saves the visible appearance of pages as PNG or JPG, while OCR reads the shapes of text in an image to treat them as text data. We do not advise using OCR to restore text that disappeared during conversion.

documentGenerator.name: 06. Bulk Generate Word
documentGenerator.blocks:
Create multiple notices with one template and one list

If you find yourself copying the same notice and changing the name and department every time, try marking the placeholders in a Word template and connecting an Excel list. This tool creates DOCX files by filling the template with list values without you having to rewrite text or send emails.

In the Word template, write a pair of curly braces where the values should go, like {Name} for the name and {Department} for the department. In the first row of Excel, write column names like Name and Department, and input the data from the second row onwards. After selecting the files, map each column to a template field, and generate one document first to check the layout, numbers, and dates.
documentGenerator.examples:
Word Template:

Hello, {Name}.
Department: {Department}
Please check the training schedule.

Excel List:

Name

Department

Min-su Kim

Sales Team

Seo-yeon Lee

Operations Team

If the file naming rule is set to {Name}_Notice.docx, the target results are Min-su Kim_Notice.docx and Seo-yeon Lee_Notice.docx respectively. Do not state that this default file name is set automatically. Example files will be provided as downloads after verifying with the actual generation engine.
documentGenerator.faqs:
The Excel column name is Customer Name and the template says {Name}.
Connect the Customer Name column to the Name field in the template. In the connection name input field, specify the name without curly braces. Check the sample after accurately mapping the template and columns.

If the preview table is correct, can I generate all the documents right away?
The preview table is a step to confirm the values to be inserted. Open the sample DOCX in your actual document program to check line breaks, tables, dates, amounts, and file names before generating everything.

Is an empty value the same as having no mapped field?
No. An empty value in a mapped column can result in blank content, but not mapping a required column is an issue that must be fixed. Check the sample to ensure no required values are missing.

documentCompare.name: 07. Compare Documents
documentCompare.blocks:
Place the pre-revision document on the left and the post-revision document on the right

When revising reports or notices multiple times, it is easy to miss what has changed. Document Compare highlights the differences in text, tables, and formatting between two versions to help you locate areas for review. Connect Word documents with Word documents, and Hangul documents with Hangul documents.

Select Web Comparison to read the changed parts immediately, or Excel Report to organize a review list. If both files are DOCX, you can also generate a Track Changes result to view in Word. Because change indicators do not judge the business significance of the document, please read them alongside the original text.
documentCompare.examples: Example: Two composite DOCXs where the submission date of the same notice is changed from "October 1" to "October 5" and only one cell in the department table is modified. Show where to check body changes and table changes respectively.
documentCompare.faqs:
Can the exact same text be marked as a change?
Formatting or internal document structure might have changed. Read the marked section along with the original and check if it's a comparison that includes formatting changes.

Do I have to read every single difference?
First, look at the list of additions, deletions, and modifications, and prioritize important details like dates, amounts, and subjects. Also check if you have selected table comparison and other document areas.

pdfCompare.name: 08. Compare PDF
pdfCompare.blocks:
Check both text comparison and visual comparison together

A PDF's text information and the visual appearance of its pages can differ. Text comparison checks the differences in the extracted text from the PDF, while visual comparison checks the differences in how the pages are drawn. Since scanned documents like photos might not have extractable text, do not assume the content is the same based solely on text results.

First, ensure that pages containing the same content are linked. If a cover page was added to the revision, subsequent pages might be shifted by one. Match the pages, run the comparison again, and review the locations of changed numbers, dates, signatures, and tables alongside the original text.
pdfCompare.examples: Example: The original is 3 pages without a cover, the revision is a new cover + 3 body pages. A diagram showing that page 1 of the original must correspond to page 2 of the revision to compare the same content. Since the current guide explicitly supports manual matching, verify the linking method in the actual UI before posting.
pdfCompare.faqs:
If the text result from a scanned PDF is empty, does it mean there is no content?
No. If the text shapes are embedded in an image, there might be no text for the PDF to extract. Check the visual comparison, and if you need searchable text, use the PDF OCR tool separately.

What should I check first if all pages look different?
First, check if the comparison pages are out of sync due to added covers, deleted pages, or order changes. If differences persist after matching the pages, check the size, orientation, and actual body text.

hwpEditor.name: 09. Edit Hangul Document
hwpEditor.blocks:
Keep the original and double-check the saved file

You can use this to quickly open a Hangul document and edit sentences or tables. Edit text, tables, and formatting within the supported range of the browser editor, and save a new file.

The fonts or complex objects used in the original document may be displayed differently. For documents to be submitted, reopen the saved file in the actual program you will use to check page counts, line breaks, table clipping, and image placements. It is best to keep important originals separately without overwriting them.
hwpEditor.examples: Add 4 items under "Check before submission" below the existing guide: Page count / Where tables break on the next page / Substitute fonts and line breaks / Actual save format. Add case images only if validated composite HWP/HWPX are available.
hwpEditor.faqs:
How is it different from the Office Editor?
This tool is specifically provided for Hangul documents like HWP and HWPX. To edit DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX, please select the Office Editor.

If it looks good on the screen, can I submit it right away?
Reopen and check the saved file. The line breaks and page layouts you saw in the browser might differ from those in the final program you use.

officeEditor.name: 10. Office Editor
officeEditor.blocks:
You can select a file even before preparation is complete

When you open the page, the browser prepares the Office editing environment. Initially, it may take some time to download the program and fonts, but from the next launch, you can reuse the saved program files. While checking the progress guide, select or drop the file you want to edit.

Once ready, the selected document will open. While editing the document, use the editor's menus and save tools instead of the site's search bar. When finished, please receive the result file via Save & Download. Reopen the downloaded file to verify fonts, pagination, and formula results before sharing.
officeEditor.examples: Short status guide: "Preparing editing environment — You can select a file in advance." / "Preparation complete — Drop the file to edit." / "Opening document" / "Downloaded the saved file." Connect the displays to the actual statuses.
officeEditor.faqs:
Will I have to download the program files again next time?
You can reuse them if the necessary program files remain in your browser. If you clear site data or use a different device/browser, it may need to be prepared again.

Is the result exactly the same as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint?
Since it is a LibreOffice-based editing environment, there may be differences in fonts, line breaks, and advanced features. Always verify important results in your original program as well.

How do I know if saving is complete?
Along with the completion notice, check whether the browser actually downloaded the result file. Just seeing the document on the screen does not mean the file save process is finished.

image.name: 11. Edit Image
image.blocks:
Photo size is different from canvas size

Changing the horizontal and vertical pixels alters the size of the image itself, while changing the canvas size alters the workspace around the photo. Decide first whether you want to send a smaller photo or add margins to fit a specific ratio.

To remove part of the content, use crop; to blur sensitive areas, use region effects; to insert text or a logo, select the corresponding editing tool. After saving, check the resulting image again to ensure it is the desired size and that no parts meant to be hidden or cropped are left.
image.examples: Example: Explain shrinking a 1600px wide photo to 800px side-by-side with keeping the photo as is and adding margins to a square canvas. Do not mislead users into thinking it has automatic crop/background removal features.
image.faqs:
Does making a small photo bigger make it clearer?
Simply increasing the pixel size does not restore details that weren't in the original. Check the text and edges after enlarging.

Is all personal information safe just by applying a mosaic?
You must manually verify the intensity of the effect and the covered area. If your goal is to clearly obscure text in a document, consider the Personal Information Redaction tool and its result verification procedure.

video.name: 12. Edit/Convert Video
video.blocks:
Choose between saving quickly or setting the exact start point

The direct copy method is fast because it doesn't recompress the video, but the start point may snap to the nearest reference playback scene. If you need to start more precisely at a designated moment, or change the size, rotation, or compatible format, consider the re-conversion method.

When merging multiple videos, you must check not only the order but also whether the aspect ratios, resolutions, and audio configurations match. After saving the result, play the beginning, connection points, and end to ensure the video and audio transition as intended.
video.examples: Example: Keeping 00:30~01:10 from a meeting recording. Explain the meaning of quick copy vs. re-conversion, but do not promise exact performance/quality numbers across all files.
video.faqs:
Can an MP4 fail to play on other devices?
MP4 is just a container format, and the internal video/audio compression methods can differ. Try playing the result on the intended device, and check the compatibility settings provided on the screen.

Why does the remaining time suddenly change?
Processing speed can vary when moving to the next video or the final merging stage. Check not only the estimated time displayed but also the current processing stage and progress logs.

audio.name: 13. Edit Audio
audio.blocks:
Choose whether to remove a section entirely or mute the sound while keeping the length

Drag to select the required section on the waveform and play it first. Delete/Cut removes the selected section and pulls the remaining audio forward. Mute leaves the length of the section intact and only silences that part.

If it's a recording that needs to match a video's length, the difference between mute and delete is crucial. Paste inserts audio at the playback position, so check your cursor location. Before saving, listen to the areas before and after the editing boundaries to ensure they don't cut off awkwardly.
audio.examples: Example: Deleting the middle 3 seconds of a 20-second recording reduces the total length, while muting the same part maintains the total length. Post after confirming with the actual implementation of selected section processing.
audio.faqs:
Does a small waveform mean the sound is quiet?
The waveform helps you locate positions and sections, but it doesn't tell you about the listening environment. Play the selected section yourself to judge.

How do I make sure my edits don't disappear?
Save the required results as WAV or MP3. Opening a new file clears the existing edit history and clipboard, so verify your results before switching to another file.

textMerger.name: 14. Merge Text
textMerger.blocks:
You can also insert titles or guiding sentences between files

Put meeting notes, various TXT files, and custom-written sentences into the same list and set their order. Adding a blank line between each card separates paragraphs, and specifying a custom delimiter makes the boundaries of the data easy to recognize.

Since this task gathers content without modifying it, it does not automatically summarize the conclusions of different documents or combine sentences with the same meaning. Check the final result to ensure titles are not duplicated and that the end of one sentence doesn't stick directly to the start of the next.
textMerger.examples: Card order: Manual input "1. Morning Meeting" → morning.txt → Manual input "2. Afternoon Meeting" → afternoon.txt. Show the result of selecting a blank line as a delimiter.
textMerger.faqs:
There are too many blank lines between files.
Check if the line breaks at the end of the original text and the selected delimiter were inserted together. Apply the options to trim leading/trailing spaces and exclude empty text only when necessary.

Will it naturally rewrite sentences to connect them?
No. It connects the entered text using the specified order and delimiters. You must manually check the phrasing and content by looking at the results.

textTools.name: 15. Clean Text
textTools.blocks:
Check the document structure before removing line breaks

If sentences copied from a PDF are broken at every line, you can use Merge Line Breaks. On the other hand, removing all line breaks from data where each line is an item, like a contact list, will destroy the boundaries between items.

Removing duplicate lines also requires caution if the same product name refers to different transactions. Apply one necessary task, compare the original with the result, and ensure the list count and spacing are as intended.
textTools.examples:
Example: The sentence "Please check
the report." can be a target for Merge Line Breaks, but "Seoul
Busan
Daegu" is a list that must maintain item boundaries. Ensure the actual combination result regarding whitespace processing matches the example sentences.
textTools.faqs:
Does it also find duplicate sentences with the same meaning?
This is not a tool for comparing the meaning of sentences. It applies fixed text rules, so you must manually judge whether sentences with different expressions have the same meaning.

What is Change English Case used for?
It is used to format multiple words into conventions like camelCase or snake_case. Before applying it to people's names or document titles, verify the result to ensure it is the desired formatting.

formatter.name: 16. Code Formatter
formatter.blocks:
Organizing for readability is different from executing it

It breaks down long strings of JSON, SQL, or XML with line breaks and indentation to make them easier to read. If an error is displayed, check the quotes, brackets, or delimiters at that location. It does not arbitrarily change invalid values to make them look like normal data.

SQL formatting does not connect to a database. Even if it is nicely formatted, it does not confirm whether the actual tables/columns exist or if the command is safe to execute. Do not share business connection details or authentication keys as examples.
formatter.examples: Show an example of minified/indented versions of the same JSON, and explain that spaces inside strings are content. Do not create a "Syntax Check Passed = Safe to Execute" badge.
formatter.faqs:
Does a well-formatted SQL statement mean it's safe to execute?
No. This tool only organizes text layout. The execution results and the risk of data modification must be evaluated separately in the actual database environment you use.

Does it automatically fix JSON errors?
It points out errors without arbitrarily changing the data. Check the structure of the original, modify it, and format it again.

work.name: 17. Workdays & Leave
work.blocks:
The length of a period is different from the actual number of working days

Distinguish between the total days between two dates on a calendar and the number of business days excluding weekends and public holidays. Days off specific to the company, like a founding anniversary or departmental holiday, must be added manually as custom holidays.

Leave calculations are reference results based on the entered reference date and calculation method. Generated leave is different from the remaining leave after usage, so always verify the actual remaining days against the company's usage records. It's also best to check if newly designated holidays are reflected before calculating.
work.examples: Example: Show how the number of business days changes when one company holiday is added to the same date range. Do not assign arbitrary dates to actual public holidays for use in examples.
work.faqs:
The results for the hire date basis and fiscal year basis are different.
This is because the reference periods used to group and calculate leave are different. Confirm the standard your company uses first, and check the generation, usage, and settlement histories separately.

Are the displayed leave days the ones I have left?
The reference value calculated for generation structure is different from the remaining balance after usage. Verify with your actual usage history and company settlement standards.

timezone.name: 18. Global Timezone
timezone.blocks:
Check based on the date of the meeting rather than the current time difference

When scheduling an overseas meeting, select the date along with the cities. Areas using Daylight Saving Time may have changing time differences depending on the season, and evening in one region might be the next morning in another.

When meeting options appear, read the local dates and times for each city together. The recommended slots are the results of comparing preset local business hours on the screen, and do not account for the actual work schedules of the companies involved or national public holidays.
timezone.examples: Example sentence format: "Seoul: [Month] [Day] [Time] / Other City: [Month] [Day] [Time]". Use actual selection results instead of fixed time difference numbers, and separately indicate cities with different dates.
timezone.faqs:
Is it an error if no overlapping times appear?
The designated business hours may not simultaneously overlap across all selected cities. Check the number of cities or the meeting date, and negotiate available times separately with the participants.

Are public holidays also recommended as business hours?
This tool compares time differences and local business hours, but does not reflect national public holidays. Check the holiday status of each region before confirming the meeting.

payroll.name: 19. Payroll Calculator
payroll.blocks:
Check the input standards before comparing with the amount deposited into your account

Monthly salary, taxable income, and non-taxable allowances might not be the same values. Read the guide for each input field, enter the appropriate amounts, and then review the resulting insurance and tax items separately.

These results are simplified calculations based on input conditions. They may differ from your actual pay slip due to the company's reported amounts, applied standards, actual attendance, and settlement methods. If the difference is significant, do not just look at the calculation result; check the input amounts, dependents, base date, and each deduction item on your slip together.
payroll.examples: Display the actual applied year / update date / input assumptions / excluded items under "Standards used for calculation" below the results. Do not hardcode legal figures and tax rates in the manuscript; fetch them from verified calculation data.
payroll.faqs:
Is the calculation wrong if it differs slightly from my pay slip?
First, check if the entered salary base and the taxable/non-taxable/deduction items on the actual slip match. This tool's simplified calculation cannot reflect the reporting and settlement differences of every company.

Can I use these results as the basis for final company settlement?
These are reference values for preliminary checking. Actual payroll and severance settlements must be processed by checking work records and applied standards.

documentRedactor.name: 20. Redact Personal Info
documentRedactor.blocks:
Final verification is still required even after adding black marks

This tool does not automatically find personal information for you. Manually check if the same contact details or names are repeated on other pages, tables, or headers. A page without redaction marks is not guaranteed to be safe.

Once the result is generated, all pages of the PDF are re-saved as images. Search, text selection, existing signatures, form fields, and links will not be maintained, so ensure this method fits your submission purpose first. When sharing, choose the new result file, not the original, and ensure the file name does not contain sensitive information.
documentRedactor.examples: Review example: A composite document where only the contact info on one page is redacted, leaving the same info in the signature block on the last page. Shows that "redacting in one place ≠ automatic total removal".
documentRedactor.faqs:
How is it different from removing hidden info in photos?
Personal Info Redaction allows you to select and obscure visible parts of documents or images. Removing photo metadata deals with information like shooting location and device stored inside the file. Choose the tool that fits your purpose.

What should I check before sharing?
Check if it is the new result file, if all pages have been reviewed, if no text remains around the edges of the black marks, and if the file name is free of personal information.

imagePrivacy.name: 21. Remove Photo Metadata
imagePrivacy.blocks:
Verify the visible appearance and the shooting data saved in the file separately

Even if an address is not visible in the photo, shooting locations and device information may be stored inside the file. This tool checks the shooting data of JPG, PNG, and WebP files and creates a copy with the information cleaned up. HEIC and HEIF are not currently supported.

Faces, names, and addresses directly captured in the photo are not obscured by this process. Handle such content with image editing or personal info redaction. After saving the new photo, check not only the shooting data but also the orientation, color, and quality, and avoid confusing the copy with the original when sharing.
imagePrivacy.examples: Do not use real GPS coordinates or device owner names when creating examples. Distinguish between "visible information / hidden information" in two columns to help users choose the right tool.
imagePrivacy.faqs:
Can the orientation or size of the photo change after removal?
You must re-verify the display orientation and file size while creating the new copy. Open the saved photo to check if it looks as desired, and keep the original separately.

If it says there is no shooting data, does it mean the photo has no personal information?
Not at all. Visible faces, addresses, and license plates are independent of shooting data. You must manually check the photo itself as well.

security.name: 22. Password Generator
security.blocks:
Check the actual required conditions before looking at the score

Generate a password after checking the length and character types allowed by the site you intend to use. Keep the generated value separate from passwords you reuse elsewhere, and check if it is successfully registered on the intended site.

The strength score and estimated crack time are comparative values based on set assumptions. It does not mean the result has been scanned to see if the account was leaked, if login attempts are restricted, or if other protection measures are in place. Do not write the actual passwords you use in bug reports or examples.
security.examples: Do not post actual usable passwords in example screenshots. Show only composite values for the UI before and after changing length/allowed characters.
security.faqs:
Does a high score mean it's confirmed not to be leaked?
No. It is the result of analyzing the pattern of the entered string. It is not a feature that queries leaked accounts or databases.

Can I see the generated password again if I close the page?
This tool does not store generation history. Before closing the page, save the chosen value in a secure storage method that you use.

qr.name: 23. QR Generator/Reader
qr.blocks:
After generating a QR image, scan it at the size you will use it

Enter the link or sentence to embed in the QR and check the preview. If there's a typo in the link, the QR will lead to the wrong address even if generated successfully. After changing the logo and color, it's best to rescan it at the actual size and against the intended background.

The reading feature shows the content inside the QR; it does not judge the safety of the linked site. Verify the address and destination before opening the link. For QRs to be printed, please check them with a printed sample on paper as well.
qr.examples: Review sequence: Check spelling of input address → Generate PNG → Scan with phone → Scan at actual print size and background. Retain the bulk auto-redecoding validation but do not expand it to a guarantee of scanning in all environments.
qr.faqs:
Can I change the address inside the QR after making it?
The generated image contains the content from when it was made. If the content changes, you must create and replace it with a new QR image. Do not instruct that this tool provides redirection management features for linked servers.

It scans well on the screen, but poorly on the printout.
Check if it was printed too small, or if margins, backgrounds, or logos overlap with the code. Print a sample at the actual intended size and scan it multiple times.
